post.summary: Create and update employees historical data in given input array. Max request size is 45mb.
post.description: This API inserts records into the employee history. If `start_date` and `end_date` (in **YYYY-MM-DD** format) are provided, it first deletes existing history records for the employees in the request body that fall within the specified date range (**inclusive**), and then inserts the new records. If no date range is provided, it simply inserts the new records without deletion.

parameters.name: authorization
parameters.description: JWT Token generated from login (Bearer token)

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date of effective range. If provided along with `end_date`, only matching records for employees in the request body will be deleted before inserting new records.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End date of effective range. If provided along with `start_date`, only matching records for employees in the request body will be deleted before inserting new records.

post.description:
This API allows updating multiple employee citations in a single request.
Each citation entry in the request body must include the `rule_id`, `user_id`,
`final_outcome` (either `Success` or `Fail`), and an `effective_date`.

**Usage notes:**
- The request body must be an array of citation objects.
- The `final_outcome` field accepts only the values `Success` or `Fail`.
- Ensure that `effective_date` is provided in `YYYY-MM-DD` format.
